task_objective: Implement the query-workspaces plan: independent restored SQL editor tabs, a durable saved-query library, safe parameter binding, and catalog-dataset binding.
tests_added: Editor tab creation, focus, independent buffers, close handling, per-tab SQL file paths, result isolation, restoration, and legacy single-draft migration.
Saved-query storage round trips, duplicate-name handling, corrupt or malformed input, and atomic interrupted-write safety.
Parameter extraction against casts, quoted literals, comments, repeated names, and safe DuckDB transport of an injection-shaped value.
Spark rejects bound query parameters before attempting to start PySpark, preserving an actionable DuckDB-only limitation.
Saved-query dock filtering and action emission; save-current-query, parameter prompt and binding, and quoted {dataset} replacement through catalog aliases.
design_decisions: A1 was a behavior-preserving accessor refactor, so it used the plan's stated TDD exemption; the pre- and post-refactor suites both reported 584 passed and 7 deselected.
Closing the final editor tab immediately creates one empty Untitled tab, avoiding a no-editor state for ordinary interaction.
Saved-query names are case-insensitively unique and duplicate names are rejected rather than silently disambiguated.
The scanner provides the only placeholder spans used for binding. Values are passed as DuckDB positional parameters, never interpolated into SQL.
Spark explicitly rejects requests carrying bound parameters; it never falls back to string substitution.
The catalog {dataset} token is an identifier and is therefore resolved with quote_identifier, separately from value binding.
The test fixture redirects SavedQueryStore.DEFAULT_PATH to tmp_path while preserving a collection-time assertion of the real runtime default path.

deferred_and_unverified: No performance measurement was made for many open tabs retaining result frames.
Prompted parameter values remain string-only; there is no typed or list-parameter support.

Parameterised saved queries are DuckDB-only. SparkEngine.execute rejects bound parameters with an explicit error rather than interpolating them; Spark users cannot run saved queries that declare :parameters.
The lexer does not support every SQL dialect construct such as dollar-quoted strings or nested block comments.
Dialog interactions are monkeypatched in tests, and no Windows-specific verification was performed.
results: The branch contains independent atomic commits for the accessor seam, tabs, per-tab results, tab restoration, saved-query storage, parameter extraction, safe binding, the saved-query dock, and dataset binding. The session record is committed separately; the final clean-tree quality gate must run before writing the round-complete marker.
